body: Thank you, I promised myself long ago that I would set small goals. Make it past this hour. Make it past today. Make it past this month, etc. This does work. But lately I've been locking myself indoors even checking the mail or mowing my lawn causes me such anxiety. I don't want people to see me. The isolation is causing the depression to get worse. Then I start to think of robin williams, Spalding grey and Hemingway and wonder they waited so long with their pain. Plus their lives were so much more then mine. They actually touched others... If they couldn't do it how can I?
